# The Challenge

SAP, a global leader in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, knows firsthand 
how quickly testing debt compounds at scale. With an engineering organization of 
roughly 40,000 people juggling at least 40 different UI testing tools, the company 
faced a unique set of challenges regarding internal consistency and developer 
efficiency.

Catching a bug in development costs a fraction of what it costs once live. And at SAP’s scale, that math matters 
enormously. By partnering with Sauce Labs, SAP successfully simplified its testing infrastructure. As an enterpriseready central platform, Sauce Labs eliminates redundancy and closes compliance gaps, setting the stage for an AIpowered future.

**01**

## Exponential complexity at enterprise scale.

Managing the developer experience for 40,000 engineers is no small feat. SAP’s central 
platform organization was tasked with providing scalable services and establishing standard 
tools to improve efficiency. However, their UI testing environment was deeply scattered.

### Fragmented tooling

Teams were using at least 40 different UI testing tools,

ranging from custom developments to various Selenium grids.

### The device dilemma

Developers faced a constant struggle with the logistical headache

of testing applications across an ever-growing variety of devices.

### High internal stakes

As a central service provider, the platform team was “under fire from day one,” as individual 
development units always believed they could build faster, more effective local solutions.

To earn and keep credibility, the platform team needed a unified, enterprise-ready 
solution that engineers would actually want to use and could satisfy both developers and 
compliance officers.

---

Why Sauce Labs

## 02 Consolidation built on what engineers cared about.

Given the scale of the problem, a top-down mandate would have invited resistance. Instead, 
SAP built the case for consolidation around what engineers cared about: getting rid of tools that 
weren’t working and replacing them with a solution that actually did.

Sauce Labs ultimately won — and retained — the business by standing out in several critical 
areas of enterprise readiness.

“(Sauce Labs) provided a central offering, an environment that 
runs in Europe, and all the certificates. Step by step, we kicked 
[competitors] out because there’s one other thing that you made 
really brilliant, which is about taking care of us as a customer.”

**MICHAEL SPINDLER · FORMER HEAD OF PLATFORM SOLUTIONS, SAP**

### Solving the device variety problem

Sauce Labs provided a central offering that effectively addressed the complex, high-demand 
testing across a massive variety of devices.

### Rigorous industry certifications

Because SAP serves hundreds of thousands of customers across highly regulated industries 
(banking, healthcare, media, communications), it requires vendors to meet its strict compliance 
standards. Sauce Labs provided the necessary certifications to give SAP’s downstream 
customers peace of mind.

##### KEY EVALUATION CRITERIA

###### European data sovereignty

An environment that runs directly in 
Europe — a mandatory requirement 
for SAP’s operational compliance.

###### True partnership

Sauce Labs acted as an extension 
of SAP’s team, directly assisting 
rollout across business units.

24/7 support

Round-the-clock support, 
seamlessly integrated into SAP’s 
central development environment.

With the right platform selected, the focus shifted to the daunting task of migrating thousands 
of developers and standardizing their workflows.

## Results

**03**

## The wins and business impact.

By partnering with Sauce Labs, SAP achieved significant operational victories.

| 40+ Tools consolidated | SAP has progressively displaced competing tools, bringing more of its teams under the Sauce Labs platform to jointly create common products — with standardization continuing to expand across the organization. |
| --- | --- |
| ~0 Internal support burden | SAP regularly measures internal user satisfaction and ticketing volume. Because Sauce Labs took on the burden of handling support tickets and ensuring a smooth rollout, the internal support burden dropped to almost nothing. |
| Seamless adoption | The hands-on partnership resulted in happy internal customers and massive adoption of the Sauce Labs solution across the engineering org. |
| AI-ready Sauce AI in the pipeline | The successful partnership has opened the door for future innovation. SAP’s teams are now actively rolling out and utilizing Sauce AI services within their autonomous testing and development pipelines. |
